The '''Cadomai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Alien Anthology]]'' places the Cadomai system in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].
